finding.cause: Source-supported selection mismatch, conditional on the fresh pool containing the expired, priority-0 added row and another still-valid stale row. Pinned chat resolves the credential pool before OAuth fallback. CredentialPool.select first chooses among currently available rows; _available_entries defers an expiring single-use row to pending_refresh, while a valid stale row remains available. select refreshes pending rows but reselects only when the pre-refresh selection was empty. It can therefore refresh added to added-rotated yet return stale for this chat. This matches the prior added→added-rotated plus stale-catalog observation and the latest stale-model marker.
